keyFindings: No new classifier phase ships. D3 already covers the 0.8B server.
Deem transport is its own client (route c), later, and does not threshold.
Do not threshold raw temperature 1.0. Health does not show the calibration file. deem-ctl has no pin.
MCP is the wrong shape for a context cut. Compaction fail-opens a missing answer.
Tare's conditioned permutation flip must not replace R1's 0.10 rerun flip.
Vendor card accuracy and JevBench 9B numbers are not this machine's quality. LOCAL p50 is speed on short inputs.
Framework-registry savings are unproven: the runtime reader found is the benchmark sweeper.
select_intents and classify_intents have no runtime definition in the .skilled code search.
Order: zero-call census, then a client only if D3 is amended, then one-question flip on a pinned commit, then no judgment arm until flip is at most 0.10.
